proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting Report Analyzing the Impact of the "System Change Scenario" on the Chemicals Business
proposals.proponent: As You Sow (on behalf of Warren Wilson College)
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report analyzing whether and how a significant reduction in virgin plastic demand, per Breaking the Plastic Wave's System Change Scenario, would affect the Company's financial position and financial statement assumptions.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote "AGAINST" proposal 4.
